newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Spescom sees more growth in 1996/97 season.
newsitem.headline: Spescom sees more growth in 1996/97 season.

text.p: South Africa's Spescom Electronics Ltd said on Monday growth achieved during the financial year ended September 30 would continue in the current year and its 1994 objective to double earnings by 1997 was well on track.
"The growth achieved during the year is expected to continue in line with Spescoms' vision made known in October 1994, of doubling earnings by September 30, 1997," the firm said in a statement.
Spescom said alliances it had set up in the telecommunications business would be major contributors to growth over the next two years.

The largest contributor to profit was Spescom MeasureGraph division which performed well in all areas of activity and was boosted by a distributorship agreement with Japan's Sony Corp for their range of broadcast products.

It said the acquisition of Chercor, a telecommunications company, helped it to conclude alliances with major leaders in the field including Lucent Technologies Business Communications Systems (formerly AT&T) and a 50/50 venture with Quante AG, a distribution network equipment company.
EML, a joint venture with Siemens AG, and suppliers of Electricity Prepayment Metering Systems, had increased its gains from exports.
The local prepayment metering market, through contracts with parastatal Eskom and municipalities, remained strong and continued to gain significant market share from competitors, the company said.
The company posted year earnings up to 31.5 cents from 25.1 cents on Monday. Attributable income rose to 9.18 million rand from 5.01 million rand previously.
